name: Custom Soundboard
description: Play your own sound effects when things happen in the game - player death, jumping, eating, being spotted by a lizard, falling, changing rooms and more. One simple text file (soundboard.yaml) decides which sound plays for which event, with volume and delay for each; press OPEN FOLDER in the mod's options screen to find it, drop in your own .wav / .ogg / .mp3 files, and press RELOAD CONFIG - no restarts and no rebuilding.
